caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical bell system mounted on a rectangular wooden board with a visible pale wood grain pattern. At the center of the composition is a metallic coil made of copper or bronze wire, tightly wound in a spiral expanding outward in a counterclockwise direction. Suspended from the end of the coil at the bottom center is a copper-colored bell with a pronounced lip and a central clapper. A vertical, dark gray or black cylindrical rod is fixed on the upper left portion of the board, attached to the end of the coil by a small bracket, and connected with a blue string or wire that runs vertically down and off the lower left edge of the wooden board. The background outside the wooden panel is a light beige or cream color.
title: Door Bell
